events.info: Killer Video Presents: Akron Independent Horror Short Film Festival Prepare yourself for a chilling, thrilling evening at the legendary Akron Civic Theatre! 4PM - 6PM | Explore a killer lineup of horror + film vendors and snag spine-tingling merch. 6 PM - 8:30 PM | Settle in for 2.5 hours of original independent horror shorts, complete with a brief intermission to catch your breath. Awards Ceremony | Celebrate the best of the fest immediately following the screenings. Step into the shadows, support indie horror, and witness the future of fear on the big screen. ONE NIGHT ONLY! Dare to attend? Recommended for ages 12 and up. Attendees under 18 must be accompanied by an adult.
